lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Enter the email address on your Rentify account. [[slnc 300]] Then press Send Code.

lines.label: enter-the-code
lines.said: We have emailed you a four-digit code. [[slnc 500]] Type it in, and the page moves on by itself.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: This is your admin dashboard. [[slnc 300]] Open Businesses to find the store you want to work on.

lines.label: find-the-business
lines.said: Start typing your business name, [[slnc 300]] then choose it from the list that drops down.

lines.label: the-business
lines.said: Your business page opens. [[slnc 300]] Choose Lookup Stores to see the stores it owns.

lines.label: find-the-store
lines.said: Type the name of the store, [[slnc 300]] and pick it from the list. [[slnc 500]] Everything after this belongs to that store alone.

lines.label: the-store
lines.said: This is the store page. [[slnc 300]] Open the gear menu and choose Lookup Collections.

lines.label: collection-list
lines.said: Here are the store's collections. [[slnc 300]] Press the plus button to start a new one.

lines.label: new-collection
lines.said: Give the collection a name. [[slnc 300]] A collection is a group of items that differ only by their options.

lines.label: collection-details
lines.said: Add a description your renters will read. [[slnc 300]] Then set the starting price, in cents — two thousand five hundred is twenty-five dollars. [[slnc 800]] Press Create once both are filled in.

lines.label: collection-options
lines.said: Options are what make one item different from another. [[slnc 800]] Each block is one choice your renter makes. [[slnc 500]] Label is what they see. [[slnc 300]] Name is the key the item saves it under, and the name is the one that must match. [[slnc 800]] Type says text or number. [[slnc 500]] Required means an item cannot be saved without it. [[slnc 500]] Values are what the dropdown offers. [[slnc 800]] These boots have two choices.

lines.label: the-collection
lines.said: The collection is saved. [[slnc 300]] Now it needs items — the actual things a renter can book.

lines.label: back-to-the-store
lines.said: Back on the store page. [[slnc 300]] Open the gear menu again, and this time choose Lookup Items.

lines.label: item-list
lines.said: These are the store's items. [[slnc 300]] Press plus to add the first one.

lines.label: new-item
lines.said: Name the item so you can recognise it later. [[slnc 500]] Then search for the collection it belongs to, and pick it. [[slnc 500]] The collection decides which options this item has to answer.

lines.label: item-details
lines.said: Fill in the item's own details. [[slnc 500]] A description, [[slnc 300]] how many you have to rent, [[slnc 300]] and the price in cents. [[slnc 800]] The requirement is the set of questions a renter answers when they book this — pick the one that fits. [[slnc 800]] Then the options you set on the collection appear as dropdowns. [[slnc 500]] Choose a brand, [[slnc 300]] a size. [[slnc 800]] Each one carries a star, which means the item cannot be saved until it has an answer. [[slnc 500]] Press Update to save it.

lines.label: first-variant
lines.said: That is the first variant saved. [[slnc 500]] Every other one is a copy of it with just one dropdown changed.

lines.label: last-variant
lines.said: All nine variants now exist in the collection — three brands, each in three sizes.

lines.label: sign-out
lines.said: Back at the dashboard when you are done. [[slnc 300]] Logout is a card here, same as the rest.

lines.label: signed-out
lines.said: You are signed out. [[slnc 500]] Your collection and all nine of its variants are saved and ready to rent.
